blurb: The blue house in Coyoacán where Frida Kahlo was born and died.

facts.h: Born and died in the same house
facts.t: Frida Kahlo was born here in 1907 and died here in 1954. Diego Rivera gave the house and its contents to the nation, and it opened as a museum in 1958.
Leon Trotsky, exiled from Stalin's Soviet Union, lived in the Blue House from 1937 to 1939. He moved to a house nearby, where a Soviet agent killed him in 1940.
